Cozy Word Puzzles

Letter Loomer

Build words by dragging letters into the center well. Clear handcrafted boards, improve your runs, and enjoy a bright, welcoming puzzle flow that feels smooth from the very first level.

50 Handmade Levels Quick Relaxing Sessions

How It Feels

Letter Loomer combines the calm look of a casual mobile game with a direct word-building mechanic. Valid letters stay in the center well, incorrect drops bounce back instantly, and each completed word lights up the board with satisfying feedback.

Simple To Learn

Drag one letter at a time into the center well and watch the target row fill as your word takes shape.

Readable Progress

Preview valid words as you build them, then finish each board with crisp visual confirmation and star-based progression.

Made For Short Sessions

Jump in for a fast round, keep your unlock progress locally, and continue through a growing chain of handcrafted levels.

Preview The Journey

From the welcoming home screen to full puzzle boards and level progression, every screen keeps the same warm color palette and focused controls.
